label: Components by mutual reachability
subgoals: Group vertices that can each reach the other
Treat a vertex on no cycle as its own component
Contract components to obtain an acyclic condensation

label: Linear-time algorithms
subgoals: Track discovery index and lowlink in one depth-first search
Pop a component when a vertex's lowlink equals its index
Run Kosaraju's two searches as the linear-time alternative

label: From components to loop reports
subgoals: Flag every vertex in a component of size two or more
Extract one short cycle from a component for the report
Break the remaining loops by disabling chosen arcs, with a warning
